title: Detail Service Tracking Log
subtitle: Vehicle Detailing Service: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Detail Service Tracking Log covers vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature. The detail service advisor records Vehicle Detailing Service events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Detail Service Tracking Log keeps Vehicle Detailing Service exceptions visible until the detail service advisor handoff.
use_case: Use Detail Service Tracking Log at detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point. Document vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature identity before Vehicle Detailing Service begins. Compare vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature findings with stated Vehicle Detailing Service criteria; route unresolved Vehicle Detailing Service issues to vehicle appearance quality reviewer.

sections.title: Tracking review and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Vehicle Detailing Service, identify responsible parties, detail bay, wash area, interior work zone, drying area, and delivery point, and the linked vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature source.

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Reconcile the latest Vehicle Detailing Service event before closeout. Detail Service Advisor identifies overdue action, the responsible party, and the event that reopens review.

blocks.guidance: Pause Vehicle Detailing Service when compatibility, damage, contamination, scope expectation, or final quality concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Vehicle Detailing Service proof and route unresolved vehicle exterior, interior, finish, material, contamination, selected package, and protected feature scope to detail service advisor.
